launcher.notes: THE ACTUAL BUG, FOUND AND KILLED - the fix for "Cannot launch: missing the Forge 11.15.1.1764 universal jar / no source was reachable". The launch preflight was checking for the Forge jar at libraries/net/minecraftforge/forge/11.15.1.1764/ (a folder that never exists) while the jar was downloaded, checksum-verified and sitting exactly where the game reads it: libraries/net/minecraftforge/forge/1.8.9-11.15.1.1764/. That is why the log said "already installed" and Play still refused to launch and blamed your internet - the network was never the problem. Now the pre-launch check reads the same single path definition the installer and the game classpath use, so they can never disagree again; it also rejects a wrong-size stub in the same step, and the error message states exactly which file is missing. Restart the launcher, accept the update prompt, press PLAY - the game starts from the files you already have.

notes: Launcher 2.7.13 "Forge from GitHub releases": the missing-Forge-universal-jar repair now downloads the Forge 11.15.1.1764 universal + OptiFine M5 jars from a dedicated GitHub release asset FIRST (same mechanism as the client updates), through a 9-source all-public mirror chain, with size+sha1 verification on EVERY attempt and poisoned-partial self-heal. Client 3.6.0 unchanged. If the PLAY button ever still reports a missing file, just press PLAY again - the preflight repair re-runs with the new sources.
